title: Tightening Fence Wire with Tool
reason: Demonstrates the process of tightening a loose strand of barbed wire using a wire tucker.

tasks.task: Show the process of using a wire tucker to tighten barbed wire.

subtasks.text: Observe the barbed wire that has become loose.

frames.caption: An older man with glasses and a beard is standing outdoors.
An older man with glasses and a beard is standing outdoors, wearing a gray jacket and a plaid shirt.
A barbed wire fence runs across a grassy field with a tree and a power line in the background.

subtasks.text: Note the device called a wire tucker being prepared for use.

frames.caption: A metal hook is attached to a fence in a grassy field.
A person is holding a metal tool with a curved handle and a flat base, used for gardening or construction.

subtasks.text: Watch the wire tucker being attached to the fence barbed wire.

frames.caption: A person is using pliers to attach a metal piece to a fence post.
A person is using pliers to remove a metal hook from a barbed wire fence.

subtasks.text: Notice the fence barbed wire becoming tight after using the wire tucker.

A person is using pliers to remove a metal hook from a barbed wire fence.

subtasks.text: Observe the speaker emphasizing that the wire is now as tight as a banjo string.
